metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: Captures an inversion problem in film form: eight people at a dinner party during a comet find other houses holding the same eight people, and try to tell the worlds apart with numbered photos, dice and glow sticks — markers that keep getting copied or lost.

metas.name: Primer
metas.description: Captures nested causal chains in parallel. Two engineers build a time machine in a garage, copies of the same people multiply across loops, and who is observing whom keeps flipping depending on which loop you are in.

metas.name: Predestination
metas.description: Captures a closed loop where a self is its own cause. A time-travelling agent on one last assignment is caught in a cycle that lands on the autonomy paradox: if the self seeking freedom was produced by the structure, what would escaping be for that self?

metas.name: Annihilation
metas.description: Captures a zone that refracts everything that passes through it. A team enters the Shimmer, where light, radio, DNA and memory are mixed across channels like a signal through a prism — plants shaped like people, animals carrying other species' traits.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description: Captures a society coming apart at street level. In 2027, after 18 years of human infertility, a burned-out bureaucrat must get one pregnant woman across a collapsing Britain of refugee camps and long-take ambushes.

metas.name: Mad Max: Fury Road
metas.description: Captures momentum as a physical state. Almost no dialogue, one chase out and one chase back — speed, heat and desperation, with a war-rig as a whole society in miniature.

metas.name: Stalker
metas.description: Captures wanting something you are afraid to actually receive. A guide leads a writer and a scientist into a forbidden Zone toward a room said to grant your innermost wish; very slow, and the slowness is the point.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
metas.description: Captures what a comic book actually feels like to read, in motion. Also a genuinely good story about a kid learning that anyone can wear the mask, by failing at it a lot.

metas.name: Under the Skin
metas.description: Captures human beings seen from outside the species. A woman drives a van around Glasgow picking up men, in real streets with hidden cameras and non-actors, and something in the routine begins to fail — images that lodge permanently.

metas.name: Her
metas.description: Captures loneliness in a warm, well-designed future. A divorced man who writes other people's love letters for a living falls for a voice in his ear, and the film takes the relationship seriously enough to let it outgrow him.

metas.name: Gattaca
metas.description: Captures a caste system built from a blood sample. A man born without genetic screening borrows another man's blood, urine and identity to reach space, while his 'valid' brother keeps challenging him to swimming races neither should survive.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description: Captures a paranoia that turns out to be an accurate description. An insurance salesman in a seaside town so pleasant it feels laminated, a sky that malfunctions, and a dawning suspicion about everyone who loves him.

metas.name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
metas.description: Captures trying to keep someone while paying to forget them. A couple erase each other after a breakup; inside the procedure, mid-deletion, he changes his mind and hides her in childhood memories the technicians haven't reached.

metas.name: Solaris
metas.description: Captures grief arriving in physical form, in orbit. A psychologist on a space station finds the crew haunted by visitors the planet below has made from their memories — including his dead wife, who knows she isn't her.

metas.name: Videodrome
metas.description: Captures a TV signal getting inside a body. A sleazy Toronto cable programmer finds a pirate broadcast of torture, becomes obsessed, and his perception and flesh start reorganising around it.

metas.name: Pi
metas.description: Captures obsession with a pattern, filmed on grain. A mathematician in a tiny New York apartment with computers made of junk, a number that Wall Street and a Hasidic sect both want, and migraines rendered as drill sounds.

metas.name: Hard to Be a God
metas.description: Captures maximalism as immersion rather than beauty. German's scientist observes a filthy, violent medieval world on another planet, forbidden to intervene, across three hours of black-and-white mud, smoke and faces pressing into the lens — total world-building with every trace of lyricism drowned.
